statements.notes: Creatine is converted to phosphocreatine which is important for short energy bursts such as sprinting and weightlifting. Depletion of phosphocreatine can result in muscular fatigue and fading muscle power.
Tamper Evident: Do not use this product if imprinted foil seal under cap is broken or missing.
Mfg. in an FDA Registered Facility using Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs)

Keep tightly closed.
Store at room temperature: 59 degrees - 86 degrees F (15 degrees to 30 degrees C).
Keep out of reach of children.

statements.notes: Caution: If you are pregnant or nursing do not take this product.
Notice: This product is sold by weight and not by volume. You can be assured of proper weight even though some settling of contents may occur during shipping and handling.
